description: This is a Java test source file for the AmqpPublisherActor component in a messaging system. It contains unit tests for publishing messages over AMQP, handling producer recovery, message properties, and message dropping when the queue is full, using mocks and test probes.

classes.name: AmqpPublisherActorTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class testing the behavior of the AmqpPublisherActor, focusing on message publishing, producer recovery, message properties, and queue drop handling.

methods.name: setupMocks
methods.description: Sets up mock JMS session and message producer, configuring responses for message creation.

methods.name: testMsgPublishedOntoFullQueueShallBeDropped
methods.description: Test publishing messages until the queue is full, then sending one more to verify it gets dropped and reported correctly.

methods.name: newMultiMappedThingDeleted
methods.description: Creates a multi-mapped outbound signal for testing message dropping.

methods.name: testRecoverPublisher
methods.description: Tests the publisher's ability to recover after producer closure, ensuring createProducer is invoked correctly.

methods.name: producerClosedDuringBackOffIsIgnored
methods.description: Verifies that closing the producer during backoff periods does not trigger unexpected retries.

methods.name: testPublishMessageWithAmqpProperties
methods.description: Tests that messages with various AMQP properties are correctly set and invalid ones are dropped.

methods.name: getPublisherActorProps
methods.description: Returns Props for creating an AmqpPublisherActor instance.

methods.name: verifyAcknowledgements
methods.description: Verifies acknowledgements sent after message publishing, including success status and labels.

methods.name: verifyPublishedMessage
methods.description: Asserts that the published message contains specific properties and headers.

methods.name: verifyPublishedMessageToReplyTarget
methods.description: Verifies that the message to the reply target has correct correlation ID and headers.

methods.name: getOutboundAddress
methods.description: Returns a fixed outbound address string.
